tests.note: Arizona: 2.5% × (40,000 − 16,600) = 585.00. State rules as in 2026; federal figures from the 2027 file (IRS Rev. Proc. 2026-35).
Arizona: 2.5% × (85,000 − 16,600) = 1,710.00. State rules as in 2026; federal figures from the 2027 file (IRS Rev. Proc. 2026-35).
Arizona: 2.5% × (150,000 − 33,200) = 2,920.00. State rules as in 2026; federal figures from the 2027 file (IRS Rev. Proc. 2026-35).
